title: Add opt-in ICC export conversion and printer-profile soft proof
source: rapidroom (original implementation with Codex; MIT LittleCMS and lcms2)
notes: Both options default off. Convert final sRGB output to a chosen local RGB profile for JPEG/PNG/TIFF and embed the same profile. Linux editor soft proof uses RGB/CMYK printer profiles as a session-only view. Relative/perceptual intent and BPC; no paper-white/gamut overlay, monitor management, wide-gamut output, CMYK export or print-quality guarantee.
